headline: Nifty rose 0.63% but *smallcaps rose 2%*
subline: Smallcaps rose 2%. About 4 stocks rose for every 1 that fell.
hero_text: Smallcap 100 rose 2% and Midcap 100 1.55%, outrunning a Nifty up 0.63%. Advances beat declines 2,177 to 539.

why.title: Overseas funds drove the bid
why.desc: FIIs net bought in cash while DIIs sold.

why.title: Media ran away from the pack
why.desc: Nifty Media jumped 5.15%, the best sector on the board.

why.title: Wall Street rallied hard
why.desc: The Dow rose 2.06% and the Nasdaq 2.11%.

sector_reasons.Media: Topped every sector on a sharp bid
sector_reasons.Realty: Ran alongside metals at the top
sector_reasons.IT: TCS and HCLTech dragged the group
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Barely moved while the tape ran
sector_reasons.Pharma: Small gain as the bid skipped defensives

bonus_text: FIIs bought Rs 7,284.03 Cr in cash. DIIs sold Rs 3,712.23 Cr. Foreign money did the lifting.
movers_note_gainers: BEL topped at 4.71%. Adani Enterprises, Titan and Jio Financial each gained over 3.5%.
movers_note_losers: TCS and HCLTech fell over 2.3% each. Coal India traded ex dividend and BSE slipped too.
watch_text: Thursday brings the BOE rate decision at 21:30 IST. Nifty max pain sits at 23,800.
lessons: The tail ran faster than the head. Smallcaps rose about 3 times as much as the Nifty.
Foreign and domestic funds disagreed. The foreign side decided the direction.
One group sat out. IT slipped while 35 of the Nifty 50 rose.
Five straight gains added 5.56% to the Nifty. The rally ran on while fear cooled.
alert_text: The BOE rate decision lands at 21:30 IST on Thursday. Forecast is 4.00% from 3.75%.
cta_headline: Small stocks led. *Thursday opens with the BOE*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Thursday 5 November, with the BOE rate call due that evening.
next_text: Thursday 5 November follows five straight Nifty gains. The BOE rate call lands at 21:30 IST.
caption_a:
Nifty rose 0.63% to 23,960.6, but smallcaps rose 2%.
Advances beat declines 2,177 to 539.
FIIs added Rs 7,284.03 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 3,712.23 Cr.
Watch: the BOE rate decision on Thursday at 21:30 IST.
